title: Term of office.–The Chairperson or a Member, as the case may be, shall hold office as such for a
text:
21. Term of office.–The Chairperson or a Member, as the case may be, shall hold office as such for a

term of three years from the date on which he enters upon his office and shall be eligible for reappointment for another term of three years:

Provided that no person shall hold office as such Chairperson or Member after he has attained the age

of sixty-seven years.
